name: entity
description: Memory for Claude Code and Codex. It keeps a record of its conversations, turns them into memories it recalls in later sessions, and keeps corrections attached to what they corrected. Runs on your machine. Requires your own Anthropic API key.

api_key.title: Anthropic API key
api_key.description: Used to encode and surface memories. Optional if ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is already in ~/.config/brain/env — a key exported only in your shell does not reach the background daemon on macOS. Get a key at https://console.anthropic.com/settings/keys.

brain_path.title: Existing brain location (optional)
brain_path.description: Absolute path to an existing brain folder (the directory containing brain.db) — e.g. one you already grew on another machine. Leave blank to start a fresh, seeded brain. You can also set BRAIN_DB_DIR in ~/.config/brain/env.
